notes.title: Hope for Happiness to Last Forever - About Crowdfunding, Comic-Con, and New Work
notes.notes:
Dear gamers, this is Little Bone Nail from the Bone Nail Studio. We have some exciting updates to share with you about our crowdfunding campaign for " Yog-Sothoth's Yard" on Modian! We've reached an incredible 3.09 million yuan in funding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125597/56dbb8d2a4cbf43d31a0cff6cf931ecd05fbeef7.png[/img]

We couldn't have done it without your amazing support! You've helped us unlock multiple reward tiers, including:
Console versions of "The Courtyard"
Emoticon packs for QQ, WeChat, and other platforms
Bilibili decorations
Steam Points Shop items (animated avatar frames, dynamic avatars, mini profile backgrounds, and stickers)
Plus, backers have the chance to receive physical postcards and mini cards as well! We're truly overwhelmed by your generosity and enthusiasm. It's beyond our wildest expectations!

Let’s check out the avatar frames we've prepared (It will be square-shaped on Steam):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125597/663cd93f22bb0d787ac8da7e9de36a680f94de06.png[/img]

We're also thrilled to announce that we'll be participating in the offline electronic game carnival "Core Fusion 2024" Guangzhou, hosted by GCORES! Come and play with us at booth 【D56】! We can't wait to see you there on May 18th and 19th in Guangzhou!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125597/7bd11dacab6ef355641a5ca1946b16688003b94a.jpg[/img]

In other exciting news, Bone Nail Studio's new game is in the works! We expect to unveil the page in May, and if all goes well, you might be able to play the demo as early as June! The working title for this new game is " Cookthulu." It's set in a world independent from " Yog-Sothoth's Yard" (but not entirely separate - our Reality/Dreamworld dual worlds and monster universe will be interconnected). Embark on a solitary culinary adventure and exploration in the polar regions!

Of course, you'll encounter all sorts of amazing companions along the way. Currently, the companions are 33% human.
We can't provide a full reveal of the main character this time because her appearance will be developed by the players yourselves...
Okay, let's cut to the chase! This time, it's an adventure game about cultivating and raising magical creatures through delicious food!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125597/730ca63703f4f4379184b29ecca6baae9a2e0116.png[/img]

As for the new game set in " Yog-Sothoth's Yard " series universe, it's still in the works. The scriptwriter needs more time to conceive and write the story. We're grateful to everyone who plays our games, and we hope to live up to your love and support. If you have any opinions or suggestions for us, please keep sending them our way! We absolutely adore them!

With the help of enthusiastic group friends, I finally managed to buy size 42 JK shoes. The unlocked cosplay from the crowdfunding will happen in May!

notes.title: Long story short: Updated All-Happy Ending, Added Batch Alchemy
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, The "Yog Sothoth‘s Yard" will be getting an update today featuring a new All-Happy Ending. This update will provide you with an alternative to all 22 previous endings. We've received a lot of likes from players after the release of Yard, and we'd like to thank you all very much for liking it!

We've seen a lot of feedback from players who wanted other possibilities after completing the 22 endings (including various branches). Therefore, after much consideration, we have added a new All-Happy Ending, which is the main content of this update. The 23rd ending and the previous 12 endings are parallel endings, so it's up to you to choose what kind of bond you want to end up with.

[h2]Yog-Sothoth's Yard Patch Note V1.0.9: [/h2]
[h3]1.Updated All-Happy Ending[/h3]
Requirements: All characters have Affinity Lv of 10, and a new option will appear at the final choice of the episode.
Added All-Happy Ending Achievement

[h3]2.Added Batch Alchemy to Random Alchemy[/h3]
which allows you to alchemize all the input Items (Max of 50 Alchemy in a single round).
Requirements:  Alchemy Lv. 6

3.Increased stacking limit for most Items and Alchemy Items
4.Increased the AP to 5 points
5.Slaughter count accumulation limit adjusted from 100,000 to 1,000,000 (some players have reached the limit so raise it)
6.The opening animation can be skipped by double clicking on it to try to solve the problem of the game getting stuck after the opening animation is played 
7.Fixed the issue of Room fee deduction (will not affect the actual Income);
8.Fixed the issue of getting duplicate Items from Slaughter after Reading the Loads;
9.Fixed the issue of Slaughter may get stuck after Reading the Loads;
10.Fixed the issue of text errors in some of the game's UI text and episode.

This update aims to smooth out issues found after launch and refine the gameplay experience. Thank you for playing Yog-Sothoth's Yard and providing feedback! Please let us know if any other problems occur. We welcome your feedback by filling out the form at [url=https://forms.gle/5iSAdEkWSVcH1oeK7]Feedback Link[/url].

Thank you again for your love, your support is the driving force behind Bone Nail Studio's continued efforts.

Yog-Sothoth's Yard Team

notes.title: Happy Halloween！
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you for your support of Yog-Sothoth's Yard！
Last week, we updated our trading cards, badges, and backgrounds on Steam. This week, we launched the promised 'Restaurant Optimization', hoping everyone can free up their hands and have fun!

[h2]---Key Updates---[/h2]
Add Supplement process in the Restaurant and optimize the Automatic Restock system.
  1. In the Restaurant, you can use [u][b][Adjustment][/b][/u] to quickly match the Menu, and use [b][u][Supplement][/u][/b] to automatically calculate the ingredients needed for the current Menu, and when there are not enough ingredients, you will automatically go to the Hoshino Shop to purchase them;
  2. Set the Automatic Restock system, in the Daily Account will appear similar to the [b][u][Restock List][/u][/b], you can choose whether to continue to Restock the Restaurant according to this list.
  3. Cooking Screen will supports automatic purchasing from Hoshino's Shop, and you can Cook with one click by selecting the corresponding quantity.

[h2]---Other updates---[/h2]
1. Fixed the issue of black screen of Deep Follower storyline and Carnival.
2. Fixed the wrong Cookbook descriptions when upgrading Haa Lou Ling's Room.
3. Removed the Soul Stone in the early Hoshino's Shop to avoid the misunderstanding that you need to buy it.(If you have already purchased this item,it will remain in your bag.)
4. Fixed the issue that clicking on  Haa Lou Ling's avatar will not open the subsequent interface.
5. Fixed the issue of English version of the [Farewell ○○] options problem.
6. Fixed the issue of 【Cuisine of the Restaurant】, and optimize part of the task description and completion judgment.
7. Fixed the issue that some buttons may disappear abnormally.
8. Strengthened the Reward tips for Exploration Increase in Forest and the Reward tips for each layer in Mining Cave Excavation.
9. Fixed text errors in the game UI text and plot.
10. Fixed the issue that the effect of the Oracle "Immersion Aroma" did not match the description.
11. Fixed the issue of the probability of getting stuck at the end of the Auction.
12. Fixed the issue of repeated CG data in the Loads.
13. Fixed the issue of repeatedly receive the Mining Rewards by SAVE/LOAD.

Tonight is Halloween. All of our team members have decided to celebrate together, because there are not only our companions here, but also the cute characters in our game. We also hope that the small yard we have created can provide you with joy and companionship. Sincerely:

notes.title: After released, what have we experienced, and what are our upcoming plans
notes.notes:
[h2]【TL;DR Version】[/h2]
- Restaurant optimization is underway, ensuring a hands-free experience for everyone.
- A debt reduction of 20 million has been completed, freeing players from burdensome loans.
- The Hotel's Star Rating standards have been lowered, requiring only 600 Clean for an upgrade.
- ‘Auto Save’ has been optimized, and ‘Save’/’Load’ shortcuts have been added to the main interface.

Hello everyone, thank you for your support of Yog-Sothoth's Yard！We're Bone Nail Studio. The game has been released for 3 days, all of our teammembers are working hard and have received a lot of feedback. We are greatly encouraged by your feedback and suggestions. With gratitude from all of us, human and non-human alike—
Thank you, truly.

In the past three days, we've released 3 patches, fixed lots of issues, the list is as follows: 
October 22, 2023 (Updated)
1 Fixed the issue that sometimes the program may be stuck while the Carnival begins.
2 Lowered Monthly Star rating requirements for ‘[b]Clean[/b]’.
3 Fixed the issue about quest descriptions for missions.
4 Fixed issue where some NPC quests incorrectly refreshed.
5 Fixed issue where Save/Load tutorial popped up when returning to main menu from ‘Save’.
6 Fixed issue of ‘Exploration Progress’’s rewards that couldn't be claimed.
7 Fixed issue of ‘Achievement’ when some players got 10-Star but achievement didn't pop.

October 21, 2023 (Updated)
1 Optimized SAVE&LOAD.
(1) Added ‘Save’and ‘Load’ buttons to the top left corner of the main interface.
(2) Provided guidance on saving and loading.
(3) Enhanced the display of the ‘Auto’ Save button for easier accessibility.
2 Fix the problem about Haa Lau Ling’s Affinity.
3 Fix some errors about the text.

October 20, 2023 (Updated)
1 Fixed the problem of UI default activation on the main interface when restarting the game.
2 Fixed the problem of duplicate archiving of some data.
3 Fixed the problem of incomplete display of cookbooks in the Catalog.
4 Fixed the problem of English version while opening the video may cause the game to get stuck.
5 Corrected the missing content in the 'Crowdfunding Thank You List'

[h3]October 23, 2023 (New)[/h3]
Improved efficiency of mine excavation and removed mine tasks beyond level 20 (existing players with the task won't be removed).
1 Added Auto Save points before key plot and carnival (auction) rounds.
2 Instant prompts during main plot progression for affection level waiting times.
3 Added system prompts when the stuff’s Affinity level needs to wait for the main plot progression.
4 Optimized rules about the one-click fill of ‘Soul Alchemy’.
5 Fixed some text errors such as the tasks about the mine.

We are collecting and evaluating other opinions and suggestions. Due to our gameplay, the underlying design is quite complex, some modification involves some data storage and reading issues. If we make significant adjustments to some data algorithms, it may cause confusion in the archived data and harm the gaming experience of players who are already playing the game. Therefore, we are making modifications carefully and hope that our modifications can effectively enhance the gaming experience.

[h2]Some key modifications:[/h2]
1. SAVE/LOAD
Save/Load shortcuts added for convenience, and "Auto Save" nodes before key plot points are added.

2. Endings:
Various values affect endings, including Evil Value, SAN, and choices. Key items for quick value boosts are provided. Regarding Evil Value and SAN value, the game provides some items for quickly increasing values through "alchemy" and "restaurant". 

3. Pressure:
Early game pressure has been reduced through Star Rating, and Excavation improvements. Further optimizations are planned.

[h2]Upcoming focus areas:[/h2]
[h3]1. Reducing the workload of Restaurant![/h3]
Future updates will focus on reducing Restaurant tasks, making gameplay more enjoyable. We will try our best not to have players repeat the task of cooking -restock.

notes.title: Official Game Release Date Set for October 20th!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that the release date for our game is now set for October 20th! No early access– we are going all in with the full version right from the start. This means you'll have access to over 500,000 words of text, featuring a complete simulation gameplay experience with 22 different endings. As a Roguelike-Simulation Game, we offer an engaging experience with diverse gameplay strategies. You can to select different Oracles to manage your hotel, earn money, and reap the rewards of extraordinary creatures.

We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all of you for your patience and support throughout this journey. We hope the game lives up to your expectations and provides you enjoyment.

If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. Thank you for being part of this incredible journey with us, and we look forward to seeing you on October 20th!

notes.title: Yog-Sothoth’s Yard Live broadcast
notes.notes: This is the first time our team has tried streaming on Steam, and we hope everyone will enjoy it.

notes.title: "Yog-Sothoth's Yard" is now available！
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that the demo for our game, "Yog-Sothoth's Yard" [b]is now available[/b] for you to download and try out! We've been working hard to address all the bugs that were reported by early players, and we're grateful for all their feedback.

In the demo, you'll be able to play as the main character and participate in some of the game's simulation and management elements. However, keep in mind that this is just a taste of what's to come! The full game will feature four female characters with their own storylines, but those are not yet included in the demo. For now, you can only experience some of the early affection system.

We're eager to hear your thoughts and suggestions, so feel free to reach out to us on Twitter“@BoneNail Studio”. And don't forget to add "Yog-Sothoth's Yard" to your wishlist and follow us to stay updated! Your support means the world to us and we appreciate it more than words can express.

Best regards,

Bone Nail
